test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Paralel**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Paralel**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Parallel**'. • It means **'(used about two lines, etc.) with the same distance between them for all their length'.** [(दो रेखाओं के संबंध में) समानांतर] • *Example: **parallel** lines...* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Foretell**: to say what will happen in the future. (पूर्वकथन करना, भविष्‍यवाणी करना) • **Expel**: to force somebody to leave a country, school, club, etc. (देश, स्‍कूल आदि से निकाल बाहर करना; निष्‍कासित करना) • **Repel**: to send or push somebody/something back or away. (किसी व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को पीछे या दूर भेज या धकेल देना) 38:Tb4a, The correct answer is '**Moving**'.
